title: A property dashboard for bookings, rentals and daily performance
summary: An Angular dashboard that gives property operators one view of bookings, rentals and portfolio performance, and the actions that matter next.
problem: Property teams lost time when booking, rental and performance data lived in disconnected tools, and nobody had a single view of the portfolio.
overview: A focused dashboard that brings bookings, rentals and performance together so operators see what needs attention without switching tools.

built.title: Booking management
built.detail: Bookings across properties in one calendar and list view.

built.title: Rental tracking
built.detail: Rental status, income and occupancy tracked per property.

built.title: Performance overview
built.detail: Daily portfolio performance at a glance.
